text: This report seeks approval for the installation of a Level 2 Pedestrian Crossover on Marine Parade Drive, approximately 260 metres west of Waterfront Drive, in the area of 58 Marine Parade Drive. Transportation Services, as part of the Council approved Vision Zero Road Safety Plan, reviewed locations for a pilot program to implement a new style of pedestrian crossovers that were recently approved for use in the Province of Ontario. Marine Parade Drive, in the area of 58 Marine Drive, was one of four locations chosen city-wide to be included in this pilot project. As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates bus service on Maine Parade Drive, City Council approval of this report is required.

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the installation of a Level 2 Pedestrian Crossover on Marine Parade Drive, approximately 260 metres west of Waterfront Drive, in the area of 58 Marine Parade Drive.
